sentences.text: Two friends want to share it fairly.
So we cut it into two equal pieces.
Both pieces are exactly the same size.
Each piece is called one half.
We write one half like this: one over two.
Two halves make one whole pizza!
Four friends want to share it fairly.
First we cut it in half, then we cut each half in half again.
Now there are four equal pieces.
Each piece is called one quarter.
We write one quarter like this: one over four.
One quarter plus two quarters makes three quarters.
One quarter plus two quarters equals what?
Write the answer on your paper.
